Pacific Transmission Consortium TECHNICAL REPORT PTR-2025-09 Seasonal Inverter & Synchronous Reserve Assessment By Dr. Elena Rostova (Principal Systems Engineer) and Marcus Chen (Grid Operations Director) Published May 12, 2025 Executive Summary: Across twelve coastal transmission corridors, battery-backed grid-forming inverters maintained frequency stability within 0.04 Hz during simulated line-trip contingencies in Q1 2025. Data telemetry sampled at 60 Hz indicated zero subsynchronous oscillation events above threshold.
